t: Tracer 'Pro Series' all-purpose, durable, deep hole construction pencil with replacement lead set and holster. Features robust aluminium design with integrated pencil sharpener, holster grip and anti-roll feature. Ideal for deep hole marking up to 145mm and general-purpose construction marking on most common materials. Supplied with 6 x 2B replacement graphite leads stored in an anti-snap lead dispenser, and site holster.
